en.headline: Man with knife wounds found in Wong Tai Sin lift; another dies after fall
en.dek: Police are investigating whether two incidents at Chiu Sin House in Wong Tai Sin Upper Estate on Saturday morning are linked, after a man with multiple cuts was found in a lift and another man was certified dead on a…
body: Police received a report at about 7.19am on Saturday of an injured man inside a lift at Chiu Sin House, Wong Tai Sin Upper Estate. Officers and ambulance staff found a 26-year-old man conscious but bleeding heavily from multiple knife wounds to the face and body. He was taken to Queen Elizabeth Hospital for treatment.
About seven minutes later, security staff reported a man lying on the podium outside the same block. Rescue personnel certified him dead at the scene. The cause of the fall is under investigation.
Police have sealed off parts of the building and are examining whether the two cases are connected. No further details on the identities of the men or any arrests have been released.

zh.headline: 黃大仙上邨電梯內發現刀傷男子 另一男墮樓死亡
zh.dek: 警方正調查黃大仙上邨昭善樓今早兩宗事故是否有關，一名男子在電梯內多處刀傷送院，另一名男子倒臥平台證實死亡。
body: 警方今早約7時19分接獲保安報案，指黃大仙上邨昭善樓電梯內有一名受傷男子。救護人員到場發現該名26歲男子雖然清醒，但面部及全身多處刀傷，流血嚴重，隨即送往伊利沙伯醫院治理。
約7分鐘後，保安再報案指有一名男子倒臥同一大廈平台，懷疑從高處墮下。救援人員到場後證實該男子當場死亡。
警方已封鎖現場進行調查，正釐清兩宗案件是否有關連。目前未有進一步公布涉事男子身分或是否有人被捕。
